notes:
Original primary full text unavailable: existing terminal acquisition miss checked; replication appendix summaries are secondary and were not used for original statistics. Replication source is author-provided updated SI Appendix obtained from the university repository; no primary table URL was supplied in the assigned locators. The specified fairness-specific first-stage effect on prestige perceptions is not separately reported. The appendix reports the overall resource-by-fairness interaction, β = 0.04, t(600) = 0.50, p = .615, which is a different test; it was not substituted. Analytic sample 604 applies to the reported moderated mediation model, but the exact requested conditional test is unlocated. Reported success refers to the authors’ verdict on the overall moderated mediation model, not a separate verdict for each component path.
